settings.label: Logo over campaign images
settings.info: Used when the header overlays a dark hero image.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Shown in browser tabs and bookmarks. Square image, at least 96 × 96px.

definition.label: Accent (buttons, links, focus, selected states)
definition.info: Defaults to the footer brown. Hover, active, selected, border and focus shades are derived from it automatically.

settings.label: Labels (sizes, prices, details)
settings.info: Used for small uppercase labels, sizes and prices.

settings.label: Shared heading letter spacing
settings.info: Shared headings and display text; specialized product/navigation typography keeps its own treatment.

settings.content: Page gutters set the side space used by shared content containers. Full-width media and sections with their own spacing keep their layout.

settings.label: Page gutter on phones
settings.info: Screens below 750px.

settings.label: Page gutter on tablets
settings.info: Screens from 750px to 1199px.

settings.label: Page gutter on large screens
settings.info: Screens from 1200px.

settings.label: Section spacing on smaller screens
settings.info: Below 990px, sections using shared spacing use 50%, 66%, 85% or 100% of Space between sections.

settings.label: Default button size
settings.info: Applies to shared boxed buttons. Product purchase buttons retain a 56px minimum; hero Small/Large choices override this size.

settings.label: Button hover effects

options.label: Sliding fill and hero label roll

settings.info: Keyboard focus keeps its visible outline in all modes. Reduced motion and global Motion off always suppress travel.

settings.label: Card surface
settings.info: Applies to shared product and article cards; custom category cards retain their own design.

settings.label: Mark low-stock sizes
settings.info: A small dot on quick-add sizes at or below the "only a few left" threshold in Product page settings.

settings.label: Size option name(s)
settings.info: Comma-separated option names treated as sizes, e.g. Size, Waist.

options.label: Video when available, otherwise second image

settings.label: Product hover animation
settings.info: Applies to alternate images and video. Videos appear only when playback is ready.

settings.label: Options shoppers must choose
settings.info: These options are never preselected, so shoppers can't add an unintended size. Comma-separated.

settings.label: Show "only a few left" at or below
settings.info: 0 turns low-stock messages off. Only counts variants where Shopify tracks inventory and doesn't sell when out of stock.

settings.label: Default reusable chart handle
settings.info: Handle of a size_chart metaobject from Content > Metaobjects, e.g. classic-shirt. Used only when no product or collection assignment applies. Leave blank to preserve template fallbacks.

settings.content: Edit reusable measurements in Admin > Content > Metaobjects. Assign a chart below by product, collection or exact product tag. Priority: product data, product rules, collection charts/rules, tag rules, default. Within a scope, the first usable rule wins.

settings.label: Apply to specific products
settings.info: Use a separate chart for products with different measurements.

settings.label: Apply to product tags
settings.info: One exact tag per line; any match applies. Case-insensitive. Blank tags are ignored. Product and collection assignments take priority.

settings.label: Reusable chart handle
settings.info: Copy the size_chart entry handle from Admin > Content > Metaobjects. Edit that entry to update all assigned products. A usable reusable chart overrides Measurements below; blank, missing or empty entries use the CSV fallback.

settings.label: Size chart picture
settings.info: Optional picture shown in the size guide. Works without a measurement table. Add image alt text in Shopify Files. A reusable chart picture takes priority.

settings.label: Measurements
settings.info: First line: Size,Chest,Length (or your headings). Then one comma-separated row per size. Enter only verified values, using the same size labels as product variants. Leave blank until verified.

settings.label: Measurement basis
settings.info: For example: garment measured flat, or body measurements. State the actual method.

settings.label: Add-to-cart animation
settings.info: The product photo flies into the cart after it is added. Follows Theme settings > Motion and reduced-motion preferences.

settings.label: Show free shipping progress
settings.info: Shown in the cart drawer and on the cart page. Set up the matching free shipping rate in Settings > Shipping and delivery.

settings.label: Free shipping minimum order
settings.info: Amount in your store's default currency, after discounts. Shoppers browsing in another currency don't see the bar.

settings.content: Create and manage discount codes in Shopify admin > Discounts. Here you only connect an existing code to products so the store can show it and try it in the cart. Shopify always decides whether a code applies and how much it saves.

settings.label: Try promotion codes automatically in the cart
settings.info: When a product with a promotion code is in the cart, the code is sent to Shopify. It stays only if Shopify accepts it.

settings.label: When codes can't be combined
settings.info: Codes a shopper enters themselves are never replaced automatically.

settings.label: Show discount code field in cart

settings.content: Products with a code in the custom.discount_code metafield use it directly. See docs/PROMOTIONS.md to create the metafield definitions.

settings.label: Metafield code priority
settings.info: Higher wins when a product matches more than one promotion.

settings.label: Show metafield codes on product cards
Shopify discount code
settings.info: Type the code exactly as it is set up in Shopify admin, for example TEE20.

settings.label: Product handles
settings.info: One per line or comma-separated. Most stable way to match products by text.

settings.label: Product title phrases
settings.info: One per line. Matches whole words, ignoring case, for example Oversized Tee.

settings.label: Product tag or promotion key
settings.info: Matches products tagged with this value, or whose custom.promotion metafield has it, for example summer-sale.

settings.label: Try this code automatically in the cart
Badge text
settings.info: Leave blank for "Code [code]".

settings.label: Product page message
settings.info: Leave blank for a standard message. Don't promise a saving: Shopify confirms eligibility in the cart.

settings.label: Shopify discount code
settings.info: Type the code exactly as it is set up in Shopify admin, for example TEE20.

settings.label: Animation level
settings.info: Shoppers who ask their device for reduced motion always get minimal motion.

settings.label: Animation tempo
settings.info: Overall speed of entrance animations. Scroll-linked scenes always follow the scroll.

settings.label: Stagger between items
settings.info: Delay between cards, words and lines that reveal one after another.

settings.label: Scroll-linked effects
settings.info: Parallax, cinematic section scenes and pinning. Turn off for simple entrance animations only.

settings.label: Phone animations
settings.info: Simplified keeps quick fades and reveals but skips pinning, parallax and scroll-linked scenes on screens under 750px.

settings.label: Smooth wheel scrolling
settings.info: Fluid mouse-wheel and touchpad scrolling on desktop. Phones keep native scrolling. Off when the visitor's device asks for reduced motion (on Windows: Settings > Accessibility > Visual effects > Animation effects), with Motion off, and in the theme editor.

settings.content: Contact information page links. These settings belong to this theme; they do not change the published store policies.

settings.label: Show these links instead of the contact information policy
settings.info: Replaces the policy text from Settings › Policies on that page. Leave off if the policy contains details you must publish, such as your business address or registration number.
